title: rosa canina f. marisensis
intro: Rosa canina f. marisensis, commonly known as the Dog Rose or Dwarf Dog Rose, is a plant species in the family Rosaceae. This plant is known for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, making it a valuable remedy for various health issues. The therapeutic actions of Rosa canina f. marisensis include reducing inflammation, soothing digestive issues, and supporting immune function. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and vitamin C, which contribute to its medicinal properties and antioxidant activities.
